title.zh: 大语言模型如何逐词生成
title.en: How an LLM Writes Word by Word

desc.zh: 每一步都是一张概率条：温度把它捏尖或摊平，top-k / top-p 砍掉长尾，再随机抽一个词，一个接一个写下去。
desc.en: Every step is a probability bar chart: temperature sharpens or flattens it, top-k and top-p trim the tail, then one word is drawn at random and appended, again and again.

legacyLayout._note: Whitespace and markup of the hand-written lesson this page was converted from, so the conversion could be checked byte for byte (specs/site-template.md §3c).
